packages.name: Coding
packages.description: Coding of the control units: factory value next to current, changed bytes marked, notes, an access code per unit and a history.

packages.name: Additive
packages.description: An additive plan for the fuel: a rotation that moves on with every refuel (for example clean - additive 1 - clean - additive 2), a reminder when the range gets low, and a history. Optional, off until you set it up.
